A.meaning: Source integrity: pinned original PDF bundle, original page/line/header and unique collector assignment reproduce
A.pass: Exact source localization/structure, never self-asserted status

B.meaning: Semantic validity: distinguish safe explicit unknownness from usable core fields
B.PASS: A passes; historical date/race/distance and start method/placing/numeric km-time EXTRACTED with correct typed values, no conflicting official controls
B.EXPLICIT_UNKNOWN: Source is valid but one or more required core values remains explicitly UNKNOWN/NOT_REPORTED/NOT_APPLICABLE; safe representation, not usable quantitative history
B.FAIL: Wrong extracted value, temporal or source conflict, malformed type/status
B.optional_flags: Gallop/DQ/qualification absent values stay NOT_REPORTED; never false from absence. DQ/qualifiers with unavailable rank/time are excluded from quantitative B, not deleted from evidence.

C.meaning: Exact historical physical venue/race bound to this observation by checked official source and bounded stable horse proof
C.PASS: Positive independently source-checked observation binding; code/name candidates insufficient

D.meaning: Historical horse identity admission is explicitly outside this task even when a bounded retrospective source link exists

E.meaning: PIT admission outside this task. Event earlier than target is necessary, never sufficient. Actual availability/cutoff proof still required

classifications.SEMANTIC_VERIFIED: Gate B PASS for quantitative core, not model admission
classifications.IDENTITY_RESEARCH_CANDIDATE: Gate A and C PASS with no temporal/source/value conflict. Explicit semantic exclusions may coexist; source evidence can be studied without using excluded performance features. Gate D/E remain NOT_APPROVED.
classifications.EXCLUDED_AMBIGUOUS_TRACK: C not PASS and venue candidates have multiple meanings
classifications.EXCLUDED_TRACK_UNVERIFIED: C not PASS with a single candidate, no proof
classifications.EXCLUDED_UNKNOWN_RESULT_CODE: Any affected result/time/placing value UNKNOWN_CODE; preserve raw code and all additional reasons
classifications.EXCLUDED_IDENTITY_UNVERIFIED: D NOT_APPROVED; all90 blocked for model use
classifications.EXCLUDED_TEMPORAL_RISK: Future/same-day history or E NOT_APPROVED; distinguish event violation and PIT_NOT_APPROVED reasons
classifications.EXCLUDED_SOURCE_CONFLICT: Failed source binding, typed-value contradiction or official comparison conflict
classifications.RESEARCH_PENDING: Any unresolved source/semantic/identity/PIT issue; never promoted by absence of errors

reason_policy: Accumulate all reasons; classifications are non-exclusive. Quantitative attrition A->B->C reported separately from model D/E blockers. Identity-study branch uses A+C, excludes affected fields and never trains.
missing_rule: No null/zero surrogate for unknown placing/time; explicit sentinels only. Missing flags not false.
temporal_rule: Same-day/date-only and future events rejected; unknown cutoff/feature availability never granted E
country_rule: Target country only for bias grouping, not source-code resolution. Historical country UNKNOWN until C source-bound
scoping_rule: No global code->venue verification. Same printed code in a different observation/date/context needs fresh positive proof.
